def solve(case):
    capacity = case['capacity']
    trials = case['trials']
    mem = {}
    order = []  # list of signatures in order of last access (least recent first)
    for i, trial in enumerate(trials):
        sig = trial['signature']
        if sig in mem:
            mem[sig] = {'last_trial': i, 'reflection': trial['reflection'], 'success': trial['success']}
            # Move to end
            order.remove(sig)
            order.append(sig)
        else:
            if len(mem) >= capacity:
                # evict least recently used
                evict = order.pop(0)
                del mem[evict]
            mem[sig] = {'last_trial': i, 'reflection': trial['reflection'], 'success': trial['success']}
            order.append(sig)
    memory = []
    for sig in order:
        entry = mem[sig]
        memory.append({
            'last_trial': entry['last_trial'],
            'reflection': entry['reflection'],
            'signature': sig,
            'success': entry['success']
        })
    signatures = list(order)
    return {'memory': memory, 'signatures': signatures}
